segments.name: Connectivity
segments.description: Provides broadband, video, telephony, mobile, and advertising services to residential and business customers, plus enterprise fiber and managed services through Lightpath, over its own network.
segments.evidence: We principally deliver broadband, video, telephony, and mobile services to residential and business customers, as well as proprietary content and advertising services in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Residential and business customers pay monthly charges for broadband, video, telephony, and mobile service tiers; advertisers pay for advertising time and services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our residential customers pay a monthly charge based on the video programming level of service, tier or package they receive and the type of equipment they select.
